title: GitLab has remediated an issue in GitLab EE affecting all versions from 19.1 before 19.3.9, 19.4 before 19.4.8, and…
description: A vulnerability in GitLab Enterprise Edition versions from 19.1 before 19.3.9, 19.4 before 19.4.8, and 19.5 before 19.5.6 could allow an authenticated user to view unredacted secret values from secret detection findings via improper authorization checks in the GitLab Duo Agent Platform.
